**Observations:**
- Large brassica leaf (likely cabbage or broccoli)
- Multiple small to medium necrotic lesions scattered across the leaf surface
- Lesions appear roughly circular/irregular with brown/tan centers
- Yellowish halo visible around some lesions
- No obvious V-shaped lesions radiating from leaf margins (rules out Black Rot)
- No water-soaked, mushy tissue collapse (rules out Bacterial Soft Rot)
- No whitish-gray fuzzy sporulation on the underside (less consistent with Downy Mildew)
- The scattered circular brown spots with yellow halos on a brassica leaf are classic for **Alternaria Leaf Spot** (*Alternaria brassicae* / *A. brassicicola*)
